defaultPolicy: Only allowlisted UTF-8 text is included; absence is deliberate unless manifest says otherwise.

omitted.group: Original Git history and private/runtime configuration
omitted.reason: Prior history and configuration may contain data or credentials; the source checkout is not republished.
omitted.restore: Create a clean repository and independent host setup.

omitted.reason: Contains embedded student/event/history/roster data or private binding literals; worker config includes compressed private data.
omitted.restore: Recreate from authorized data in server-only private storage, not source files or browser bundles.

omitted.group: artifacts/**, dist/**, .sites-runtime/**, node_modules/**, .openai/** and archive files
omitted.reason: Generated payloads, deployment identity, cached/binary material and private snapshots are out of scope.
omitted.restore: Regenerate only from the approved sanitized source and private runtime inputs in the intended environment.

omitted.group: Raw academy-context reconstruction JSON, conversations, private pages and original provenance IDs
omitted.reason: Includes real student facts and private user context.
omitted.restore: Use the newly written generic business packet; reconsult private sources only when authorized for a separate task.

omitted.group: Raw DOM, screenshots, HAR, saved response fixtures, endpoint sample requests/results and native identifiers
omitted.reason: Potential student, account and session data.
omitted.restore: Collect a bounded new sample through approved access and keep it out of Git.

omitted.group: Unsafe and unreviewed tests, input-preparation scripts, original build scripts, original README and renderer-original.ts
omitted.reason: Hardcoded real roster/provenance or environment-coupled dependencies.
omitted.restore: Port in the selected coding environment using newly created fictional fixtures.

omitted.reason: Read original private context and assert exact message IDs.
omitted.restore: Keep only the synthetic pure-validator subset and create explicit nonprivate provenance tests.

omitted.reason: Contains private source paths, history bindings or authority text; not suitable for repository handoff.
omitted.restore: Use the sanitized architecture and current explicit authority, not historical text.

intentionalTransformations: Replace private source page/message/profile/space literals in four legacy source modules with fictional/redacted placeholders.
Replace original account repository provenance with generic source-repository labels.
Rebase clinic module imports to the included abstract architecture and type contract.
Replace private fixture-filename provenance in source-contract metadata.
Mark proposed clinic endpoint unavailable when omitted private fixture loader is absent.
Retain only synthetic logical-model tests and write results to stdout.
Change preview test happy-dom import to package import; no test execution performed.
Generalize historical student-capture counts and remove the old snapshot-count field name.
Replace hardcoded preparation-reminder clock/timezone with a caller-supplied workdayReminders contract; preserve verified personal teaching day versus delegated-session audit semantics.
Classify original source metadata locators as historical_nonportable_locator with an explicit mapping document.
limitations: No encrypted/compressed/binary data files are exported.
No credentials, auth cookies or student facts should be added to repository configuration.
Known pattern scanning plus independent review reduces disclosure risk but cannot certify unseen source information.
